row.notes: Penalty log vector this+8..+0x10 (stride 0x30): finds a record equal to arg (bytes +8..+0xb, ints +0xc..+0x18, byte +0x1c, int +0x20, floats +0x24/+0x28, int +0x2c), shifts the tail down, size -= 0x30 and calls the freed slot's vtable slot 0 (destructor). Never appends; not found -> error trace code 2 with RtlCaptureStackBackTrace. Callers Sess_PenaltyLog_ReceiveAddRecord, RemoveVehicle, SendRecord, SendRecord_2.

verify.notes: V3775 Loop compares record fields (+8..+0xb, ints +0xc..+0x20, +0x1c, floats +0x24/+0x28, +0x2c) with param_2 and on a match ERASES it (shifts followers down, shrinks end -0x30); when absent it only does an error-trace (code 2) and returns - it never appends. Better name Sess_PenaltyLog_RemoveMatchingRecord.
